aerodynamics.derivation: Effective drag-power coefficient from the difference in public forward-flight power at 6.71 and 13.41 m/s divided by the corresponding cubic-speed difference.

battery.internal_dynamics: Battery energy is represented by the public 600 Wh reference; electrical transient parameters remain uncalibrated.

collision_envelope.claim: Conservative spherical envelope for software collision checking.
collision_envelope.derivation: Half the official 1.668 m unfolded propeller dimension plus the 0.15 m project planning margin.

controller.derivation: Second-order gain design using the nominal M600 inertia.

development_limits.classification: Manufacturer tilt limit combined with project engineering performance screens.
development_limits.source: Lower public power-speed knot, DJI 25-degree pitch limit and project dynamics screens.

inertia_intervals_kg_m2.nominal_derivation: Geometric inertia prior bounded by official dimensions and mass.

mass_inertia.provenance: Official mass with a geometric inertia prior and explicit sensitivity intervals.

rotor_allocation.actuator_provenance: Software sensitivity interval for the effective actuator response.
rotor_allocation.yaw_moment_provenance: Software sensitivity interval for the effective yaw moment arm.

scientific_identity: Effective six-rotor M600 software dynamics and control model based on public specifications and phase-average power data.
uncertainty_policy: Nominal parameter values are accompanied by explicit interval-sensitivity assumptions.
